For MS/MS peptides were selected for a 1 s time window in between master scans in a data-dependent mode with HCD at 30% NCE, to be detected in the Orbitrap with a resolution of 30000.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were in-gel digested with trypsin and desalted as described in https://doi.org/10.1021/pr500164j.

In all searches a FDR of 0.01 was applied for PSM, protein, and site decoy fraction. The minimal peptide length was 7 amino acids, the enzyme specificity was set to Trypsin/P and two missed cleavages were tolerated.

instrument.evidence: Peptides were analyzed on a Fusion Lumos Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

ionization_type.evidence: Eluted peptides were electrosprayed on-line into the Fusion Lumos Tribrid with a spray voltage of 2.0 kV and capillary temperature of 305°C.

labeling.evidence: Proteins were quantified by LFQ as implemented in MaxQuant with default settings and the ‘Match between runs’ option enabled.
